records.artist: Anonymous, after a model by Simon François
records.title: Portrait de saint Vincent de Paul
records.photoRightsOrUsageGate: Paris Musées CC0 (object and source-photo identity confirmed)
records.editorialExactnessNotes: Exact Vincent portrait. The museum attributes this anonymous panel as after Simon François, not an autograph Simon François original. Painting support is oil on wood. High-quality photographic master remains to be downloaded and SHA-256 checked.

records.title: Saint Vincent de Paul Preaching to the Court of Louis XIII on Behalf of the Abandoned Children
records.photoRightsOrUsageGate: Painting public domain; Commons photographic record (reproduction details to retain)
records.editorialExactnessNotes: Exact narrative of the saint, not a solo portrait. Yale primary accession corroborated in its 2017 acquisitions bulletin. This is distinct from the two previously researched Saint-Eustache Vincent paintings.

records.title: Saint Louis à Damiette
records.photoRightsOrUsageGate: Paris Musées CC0; Commons lists a CC0 image with museum credit
records.editorialExactnessNotes: Original oil scene of Louis IX at Damietta, distinct from Jouvenet Saint Louis tending the wounded. It is an imagined nineteenth-century narrative, not a contemporary portrait. Verify external file actually loads in browser.

records.title: Saint François de Sales donnant la règle de la Visitation à sainte Jeanne de Chantal
records.photoRightsOrUsageGate: Historic original public domain; modern in-situ photo reuse to be audited
records.editorialExactnessNotes: Exact Saint Francis de Sales and Jeanne de Chantal Visitation scene. Not interchangeable with school-of-Champaigne portrait W17; painting details in French national protected-movable-objects record.

records.artist: Eustache Le Sueur / attribution to be independently checked
records.title: Saint Louis soignant les malades
records.photoRightsOrUsageGate: Commons flags DISPUTED COPYRIGHT INFORMATION on this photograph
records.editorialExactnessNotes: Original saint-nursing scene confirmed in Louvre discussion of the four-picture Marmoutier cycle. Uncertain original-versus-workshop history and an explicit Commons copyright notice; shown for source context, not rating.

records.title: Guérison de saint Jean-Marie Vianney
records.photoRightsOrUsageGate: Third-party in-situ photograph; attribution and framing unsuitable for direct image-master acceptance
records.editorialExactnessNotes: 1843 oil painting at Ars depicting Vianney sick in bed, a priest bringing chalice and Saint Philomena. Not an isolated portrait. The photographed shrine artwork is a physical-original reference only.

records.artist: Attributed on Commons to Francesco Podesti
records.title: Apparizione a Marguerite Marie Alacoque
records.museum: Vatican Museums (claim on Commons; not independently verified)
records.photoRightsOrUsageGate: Photograph claims CC BY-SA 4.0; low-resolution and custodian attribution remains unchecked
records.editorialExactnessNotes: Correct iconographic topic but insufficient source-original identity and small resolution. Do not mark as candidate for final art review or production.

provenanceNotes: P863 Musée Carnavalet is an anonymous circa-1660 oil after Simon François; not autograph, CC0 by Paris Musées and 3464x4682 Commons original.
PDUT1793 by Pierre-Nolasque Bergeret is a separate Petit Palais Saint Louis at Damietta original, 2973x2462 CC0; not the Versailles Jouvenet Louis original.
Yale accession 2017.65.1 Paul Delaroche Vincent preaching for abandoned children (1823) separately validated by Yale acquisitions bulletin; Commons preview 1278x1920.
Noël Hallé Francis de Sales / Jeanne de Chantal is an actual original in Église Saint-Louis-en-l'Île, Palissy PM75001042. Modern photographic usage not yet audited.
Le Sueur Saint Louis nursing sick in Tours (793.1.3) is held: Commons original-photo license explicitly disputed; attribution original/workshop historic ambiguity.
Ars Vianney 1843 PM01002671 is pictured as an in-situ framed photograph, not acceptable clean unframed master. Distinct from archival drawn Vianney portrait.
Podesti Vatican Margaret Mary Commons claimed attribution not independently confirmed by custodian, preview only 800x600 and no robust master.
No fake paintings, no Fran Angelico/El Greco, no duplicate physical originals, no previous 0-2 exclusions altered.
